Starting the Club

I founded and served as President of the Muhlenberg Pokémon Club, also called the ’Berg Pokémon Club. I formally established it through the application and presentation process of the college’s Student Government Association (SGA).

From there, I worked with the club’s board to organize in-person meetings for students interested in Pokémon.

More Than One Way to Enjoy Pokémon

Our meetings covered many parts of the franchise. Different interests could share the same room, rather than the club being limited to one game or format.

  • Pokémon video games
  • The Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG)
  • Pokémon GO
  • Pokémon Showdown
  • The original 1990s board game, “Pokémon: Master Trainer”
  • Discussion and other Pokémon activities
